steps.title: Configure App Metadata
steps.description: Establish basic project configuration details in app-meta.json.

steps.title: Define Database and API Schema
steps.description: Create api_schema.json defining booking collections and internal offline calculation details.

steps.title: Configure Build Settings
steps.description: Configure app build.gradle settings with target SDK 34 and appropriate parameters.

steps.title: Declare Application Manifest
steps.description: Set up permissions, launcher activity, and custom Material layout themes in AndroidManifest.xml.

steps.title: Establish Aesthetic Style Assets
steps.description: Create custom shapes, styling colors, and styles matching GrandStay's visual language.

steps.title: Implement Custom Image Delivery Utility
steps.description: Create ImageLoader.java to asynchronously load and cache remote hotel room images with absolute standard libraries.

steps.title: Implement Backend API Client
steps.description: Build dynamic authentication, forgot password flow, and REST API database connection module.

steps.title: Create Room Model
steps.description: Create Room.java entity featuring room details and collection of related high-definition preview images.

steps.title: Build Login Screen and Layout
steps.description: Create Login UI and logic verifying credentials, storing token, and loading dynamic app configuration.

steps.title: Build Register Screen and Layout
steps.description: Create Signup UI with validation routines, registration feedback, and automated session initialization.

steps.title: Build Forgot Password Recovery Stream
steps.description: Develop Gmail OTP validation and target key reset interface for secure password restoration.

steps.title: Build Main Hotel Dashboard
steps.description: Develop catalog browsing panel with dynamic keyword and price-range search system.

steps.title: Build Multi-Image Room Detail View
steps.description: Construct detail page containing multi-image landscape slider, dates choosing dialog, and dynamic calculation model.

steps.title: Build Guest Bookings Management Screen
steps.description: Develop history list component demonstrating active bookings details fetched from server.

steps.title: Inject Asset app-meta.json
steps.description: Write asset app-meta.json to make application name and parameters discoverable by client code at runtime.

steps.title: Building GrandStay Hotel & Resort
steps.description: Execute native assembly build step to generate the final GrandStay application.
